stage: expert_study — is the 210-structure task human-solvable from the renders? NOT RUN; recorded as an open gap
status: NOT RUN — no qualified respondent was collected. Recorded as an open gap, NOT as a result, and no substitute assertion is made anywhere in the paper.
gap: human baseline / checkability of the render task

eval.set: a complete 50-structure packet: balanced sample verified representative of the eval set, blinded identifiers
eval.protocol: hierarchical scoring rubric, instructions, blind answer sheet, private answer key (cp11_ANSWER_KEY.json). score_expert.py written and VALIDATED against synthetic perfect, random and realistic sheets before any real sheet was scored

prereg.committed: the protocol note carried the pre-registered predictions, and the authenticity screen was committed BEFORE the one sheet arrived
prereg.predictions: including P3': trigonal as the single predicted human failure mode, 0/7 separable by cell outline alone
prereg.screen: four independent authenticity diagnostics (S1 beats chance; S2 confidence tracks correctness; S3 notes not uniformly self-consistent at chance; S4 timing not on a grid), applied to every sheet
prereg.if_volunteers_materialize_later: run as specified without modification: 50 structures, documented qualifications, inter-annotator agreement, the trigonal/hexagonal item, per-item confidence and time. The pre-registered authenticity screen applies to every sheet

excluded_sheet.file: v676d1545_response_sheet_1.csv (original absolute path removed for release; identified by filename only)
excluded_sheet.reason: scored 18%, essentially the 14.3% chance rate for 7 classes, and failed all four independent authenticity diagnostics
excluded_sheet.exclusion_type: AUTHENTICITY exclusion, not a result-based one — the distinction matters and was maintained when it would have been convenient to blur it: no sheet may be excluded for producing an inconvenient number

detail_files.scoring_test.json: the scorer's per-sheet output: per-system correct counts, confusion tallies, Wilson intervals and the screen decision for both sheets
detail_files.cp11_ANSWER_KEY.json: the private 50-item key (item_id, material_id, truth crystal system, b1_ok / v2b_ok / rf_ok flags, and the five view image filenames per item)

cost_to_the_paper.unavailable_claim: the checkability framing — 'the only row whose input a human could check by eye' — is NOT AVAILABLE, and every sentence depending on it must be DELETED rather than softened

substitute_for_the_information_question.why_it_helps: it isolates information content from human skill in a way a human baseline cannot

cost_to_the_paper.why_the_oracle_does_not_substitute_for_h: it assumes perfect atom localisation, which is the hard part
three_corrections_governing_how_the_boun: a 280-structure sample with ZERO overlap with the eval set
cost_to_the_paper.trigonal_hexagonal_record: its trigonal/hexagonal mirror also stops short of settling this: BOTH model arms fail the same confusable pair in OPPOSITE directions, strong evidence of intrinsic render ambiguity, but only a human who separates the pair cleanly would prove the information is present and the failure is the models'

required_limitations_sentence: No human baseline was collected. The oracle bound substitutes for the information question; the checkability claim is not made.
reconciliation: 0.9321 -> 0.9357: the identifiability harness was rerun to record box-sufficiency per row; the rerun's 4-view value is 0.9357 (262/280) against the original 0.9321 (261/280). One structure of 280; the harness draws from a LIVE database so the seed fixes draw order, not the candidate pool. 0.9357 is the current value.
conclusion: No human baseline exists. The instrument is complete and validated and the single sheet received was excluded under a pre-registered authenticity screen it failed on all four diagnostics (18% accuracy, at the 14.3% chance rate). The checkability claim is withdrawn from the paper rather than softened; the oracle answers only the information question, not human solvability.
_provenance: the 50-structure packet, protocol and private key built for this record; score_expert.py validated on synthetic sheets before scoring; per-sheet output in scoring_test.json, key in cp11_ANSWER_KEY.json
